title: I used Astra + Three.js to build a speedboat racing game
author: maa1l
selftext:
I used Astra to build this little speedboat racing game with Three.js.  
  
I started by describing the game I wanted: a top-down arcade-style speedboat racer that runs entirely in the browser. From there, I used Astra to generate and iterate on the Three.js implementation; the boat controls and physics, water, camera, obstacles, environment, and overall gameplay.

Most of the process was basically me playing the game, spotting things that didn't feel right, and then prompting Astra to change them. I spent quite a bit of time tweaking how the boat accelerates, turns and drifts, as well as getting the water and wake to feel right.

Pretty happy with how it turned out, especially the water and how the speedboat feels to control.

It runs directly in the browser on desktop, iOS and Android.

Try it here:  
[https://games.tinyappstudio.io/speedboat](https://games.tinyappstudio.io/speedboat)

Would love to know how the controls feel!
